title: Lightning Sensor False-Strike Ratio
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightning:strike
| stats count as total_strikes, count(eval(validated="false")) as false_strikes by sensor
| eval false_pct=round(100*false_strikes/total_strikes,1)
| where total_strikes>0 AND false_pct>20
| sort - false_pct
description: Uses Lightning strike telemetry telemetry to monitor how many hits the sensor later marked as false in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for detectors that need placement or filtering changes, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Lightning strike telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how many hits the sensor later marked as false so you can spot detectors that need placement or filtering changes before it becomes annoying.
